compute_multiscale_ssim: compute the multi-scale structural similarity index between two batches of images using multiscale_structural_similarity
build_gaussian_window: build a 2D Gaussian window tensor for SSIM calculations using _gaussian_window with a given window size and std
test_ssim_single_channel: test the single-channel SSIM computation between two image batches using _ssim_single_channel
refactor_ssim_multichannel: refactor _ssim_multichannel to apply SSIM independently across each channel of multi-channel images
review_pad_and_downsample: review _pad_and_downsample which pads and average-pools images to match Tensorflow MS-SSIM downsampling behavior
